title: Orbit Cadence
archiveRole: First Rhythm Audio Hall observation sample
description: A PC-first rhythm audio benchmark about reading four orbital lanes, hitting timing windows with keyboard or pad input, protecting combo and integrity, and riding a rising cadence until extraction.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: PC-first rhythm benchmark tuned for keyboard timing at 1440x900 and 1920x1080. Mobile baseline supports loading, no horizontal overflow, and large lane-pad taps in local browser viewports, but precise timing is intended for desktop. No physical handset QA is claimed.
